capabilities: Show colorful animations when typing characters
Apply editor jitter that responds to typing intensity
Award experience points for every character typed
disambiguation: Not a code editor; it adds visual and auditory effects to the note-taking process.
intentEvidence: Transform your Obsidian editing into an epic adventure!
problem: The standard note-taking experience lacks engaging or rewarding feedback for writing and editing.

summary: Transforms the Obsidian editing experience into an adventure using visual effects, sound, and an XP/leveling system for every keystroke.
